title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: Ryland Grace is the sole survivor on a desperate, last-chance mission—and if he fails, humanity and the earth itself are doomed.

title: Atomic Habits: An Easy & Proven Way to Build Good Habits & Break Bad Ones
author: James Clear
description: A supremely practical guide on how to change your habits and get 1% better every day using small, actionable systems.

title: Klara and the Sun
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
description: The story of Klara, an Artificial Friend with outstanding observational qualities, who watches the behavior of those who come in to browse.

title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
author: Gabrielle Zevin
description: A dazzling novel about two childhood friends who reunite in college to design video games and find overnight fame and tragedy.

title: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
author: Robert C. Martin
description: Even bad code can function. But if code isn't clean, it can bring a development organization to its knees.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer: Your Journey To Mastery
author: David Thomas, Andrew Hunt
description: Written as a series of self-contained sections and filled with entertaining anecdotes and thought-provoking examples for software developers.

title: Lessons in Chemistry
author: Bonnie Garmus
description: Set in 1960s California, chemist Elizabeth Zott is forced to become the reluctant host of America's most beloved cooking show.

title: Demon Copperhead
author: Barbara Kingsolver
description: Pulitzer Prize winner set in the mountains of southern Appalachia. A brilliant modern reimagining of David Copperfield.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: One hundred thousand years ago, at least six human species inhabited the earth. Today there is just one: Homo sapiens.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
description: Aging and reclusive Hollywood movie icon Evelyn Hugo is finally ready to tell the truth about her glamorous and scandalous life.

title: Babel: Or the Necessity of Violence
author: R.F. Kuang
description: An Oxford student finds himself torn between his loyalty to the British Empire and the revolutionary resistance to its exploitation of magic.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
description: Nobel laureate Daniel Kahneman takes us on a groundbreaking tour of the mind and explains the two systems that drive the way we think.
